replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: Principal Component Analysis (PCA) is a technique used to reduce the dimensionality of data. First, standardize the data. Then, compute the covariance matrix. Next, calculate the eigenvalues and eigenvectors of the covariance matrix. Sort the eigenvalues in descending order and select the top k eigenvalues. Finally, form a matrix with the corresponding eigenvectors and transform the original data. The math can be complex, but there are software tools that can help you perform PCA without getting too anxious about the underlying mathematics.
